_comment: Health & care staffing, France, 30 h from year 1. Section-Q hours ratio from ../../v62 (primary scenario, employees capped).

NRS.label: Nurses (practising)
NRS.lead_time_note: VERIFIED: 3-year state diploma (4,620 h from Sept 2026, arrêté of 20 Feb 2026)

PHYS.label: Physicians (practising)
PHYS.lead_time_note: VERIFIED: general practice in France = 6 + 4 years (4th year of DES since the 2023 reform; first placements Nov 2026). Series break in 2020 ('b'): trend window 2020-2023. Self-employed physicians partly outside the primary cap: extra_needed is an upper bound.

PER_CARE.label: Caring personnel (health-care assistants, home-based personal care)
PER_CARE.lead_time_note: CONFIRMED_WITH_CAVEAT: aide-soignant diploma 1,540 h (~11 months), from a training institute copy; no graduate series in Eurostat (MISSING)

missing.licensed_not_practising: France does not report 'licensed to practise' to Eurostat: the pool of qualified people not practising cannot be measured here (MISSING). National sources (DREES) are a follow-up task.
missing.caring_personnel_after_2021: Caring-personnel stock is published only to 2021; 2021 is used.
missing.occupation_specific_hours: No occupation-specific weekly hours; the NACE Q full-time/part-time ratio is applied to every occupation.
